See also: музеи and музеј

Bulgarian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian музе́й (muzéj), а transliteration of Ancient Greek μουσεῖον (mouseîon).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [moˈzɛj]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɛj

Noun

[edit]

музе́й • (muzéj) m (relational adjective музе́ен)

  1. museum (both as institution and as building)
    за музе́я съм ― za muzéja sǎm ― to be old, ancient (literally, “to belong to a museum”)
  2. (+ а place name) historically important place preserved in its authentic form
    къ́ща-музе́й ― kǎ́šta-muzéj ― house museum
    сгра́да-музе́й ― sgráda-muzéj ― building museum
    се́ло-музе́й ― sélo-muzéj ― village museum
    гра́д-музе́й ― grád-muzéj ― city museum

Pannonian Rusyn

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Serbo-Croatian музеј / muzej, ultimately from Ancient Greek μουσεῖον (mouseîon).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈmuzɛj]
  • Rhymes: -uzɛj
  • Hyphenation: му‧зей

Noun

[edit]

музей (muzej) m inan (relational adjective музейни or музейски)

  1. museum

Usage notes

[edit]
  • As the singular genitive form, музею (muzeju) is far more common than музея (muzeja). The latter is nonetheless used in a not insignificant number of writings, but is officially considered incorrect.

Declension

[edit]
Declension of музей (muzej)
singular plural
nominative музей (muzej) музеї (muzeji)
genitive музею / музея (muzeju / muzeja) музейох (muzejox)
dative музею (muzeju) музейом (muzejom)
accusative музей (muzej) музеї (muzeji)
instrumental музейом (muzejom) музеями (muzejami)
locative музею (muzeju) музейох (muzejox)
vocative музею (muzeju) музеї (muzeji)

References

[edit]
  • Medʹeši, H.; Fejsa, M.; Timko-Djitko, O. (2010), “музей”, in Ramač, Ju., editor, Руско-сербски словнїк [Rusyn-Serbian Dictionary] (in Pannonian Rusyn), Novi Sad: Faculty of Philosophy
  • Fejsa, M.; Šlemender, M.; Čelʹovski, S. (2022), “museum”, in Анґлийско-руски словнїк [English-Rusyn Dictionary] (in Pannonian Rusyn), Novi Sad: Faculty of Philosophy; Ruska matka, →ISBN, page 185

Ukrainian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Polish muzeum or German Museum, from Latin mūsēum, from Ancient Greek μουσεῖον (mouseîon), with -ей (-ej).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [mʊˈzɛi̯]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

музе́й • (muzéj) m inan (genitive музе́ю, nominative plural музе́ї, genitive plural музе́їв, relational adjective музе́йний)

  1. museum
